parts:
Here’s a warm, real, slightly cheeky post that keeps the heart front and center and still has that “wow, time flies” energy:

---

My baby turned 18… and somehow that meant taking him to his very first 18+ EDM concert.  

One minute I was teaching this kid how to tie his shoes and blasting music in the car with the windows down, the next I’m standing in a crowd, lights flashing, bass thumping, watching my son experience something that once felt like *my* world.  

It was surreal in the best way.  
Sharing a piece of my own youth with him while also stepping into this new chapter of adulthood together. Childhood memories meeting grown-up moments. Me and my boy. And a few of my friends who probably felt the same mix of “this is fun” and “wow, I am tired” 😅  

I loved seeing him light up. Confident. Curious. Taking it all in. It reminded me how much I genuinely enjoy *who he is* as a human, not just as my kid.  

We danced. We laughed. We stayed out late.  
And yes… I definitely felt old. And honestly, I was very happy to come home and crawl into bed knowing those nights are mostly behind me now 😂  

But I wouldn’t trade that night for anything.  
Getting loose once in a while is fun, but watching your son step into adulthood with kindness, confidence, and character? That’s the real high.  

I love you more than words, Donovan.  
So proud of the man you’re becoming and so excited to watch what you do next.  
Always your biggest fan. 💙
